title: Boosting-Inspired Validation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Structured Scientific Knowledge Bases

contributions.purpose: 提出针对RAG的验证循环框架(而非优化检索/排序)
contributions.mechanism: 融合 boosting 残差追踪 + FLARE 前瞻式扩展:未覆盖证据视为残差,超阈值则扩图重检索,否则停止
contributions.evaluation: 概念验证,pilot 仅5条query,禁用迭代更新
contributions.domain: 检索增强生成(RAG)验证 / 科学知识库
contributions.source_quote: a boosting-inspired evaluation framework for RAG that combines iterative error reduction with forward-looking retrieval mechanisms from FLARE

contributions.purpose: 在Citavi结构化文献库中验证可行性并暴露度量局限
contributions.mechanism: 在Citavi测试项目上跑评估器,计算 Coverage@5/Semantic Coverage/nDCG/Gap-FLARE/Diversity-FLARE
contributions.evaluation: 严格字符串匹配 Coverage@5=0(全5条query),语义仅1/5部分正确,评估器全部返回"expand";nDCG 全0
contributions.source_quote: Exact string matching yielded no correct hits, while semantic inspection revealed partial correctness in one case. In all cases, the evaluator returned the decision to expand.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike existing work that primarily optimizes retrieval or ranking, our focus is on the validation loop itself.
